title: NYU Taiwanese American Student Society
content_html:
The NYU Taiwanese American Student Society (TASS) is a student organization at New York University founded in 2002. According to its website, TASS was established “with the goal and intention of creating a welcoming and unified family that could come together to learn and appreciate Taiwanese culture.” The organization describes itself as working to build “an integrated community where people can feel comfortable socializing and meeting new people among its hundreds of members.”

TASS holds numerous social gatherings each semester, including recurring events such as Game Night, Taste of Taiwan, and an annual Night Market. The organization also runs a Family System — a structured program of smaller weekly gatherings where members connect over traditional Taiwanese snacks and bubble milk tea. Its Instagram account (@tass.nyu) has over 1,200 followers and describes TASS as the destination for “everything Taiwanese at NYU.” The Facebook page has accumulated over 1,800 likes since the organization established its social media presence.

TASS is one of two Taiwanese student organizations at NYU, alongside the Taiwanese Student Association – All-University (TSA), which primarily serves students from Taiwan. TASS focuses on Taiwanese American identity and culture, welcoming students of all backgrounds with an interest in Taiwan.
